verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Cerebras-hosted access: public API endpoints, the cloud console, partner APIs, and dedicated endpoints. A dedicated endpoint is a private instance on Cerebras-reserved capacity, not something the customer runs themselves. No evidence shows customers can deploy or run the core inference product on their own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
